# TensorFlow

> TensorFlow is Google's open-source machine learning platform providing tools and libraries for building, training, and deploying ML models across desktop, web, mobile, and production environments.

TensorFlow offers a comprehensive ecosystem including core Python APIs, JavaScript support via TensorFlow.js, edge deployment through LiteRT/TensorFlow Lite, and production ML pipelines via TensorFlow Extended (TFX). The platform serves developers from beginners to production ML engineers with extensive documentation, tutorials, and pre-trained models.

## Key Topics

- TensorFlow
- Machine Learning
- Neural Networks
- Keras API
- Python
- JavaScript
- TensorFlow.js
- TensorFlow Lite
- TFX (TensorFlow Extended)
- GPU Training
- Model Deployment
- Edge Computing
- Responsible AI
- Data Preparation
- Google Colab

## Getting Started

- [TensorFlow](https://www.tensorflow.org): TensorFlow homepage showcasing ML platform ecosystem and tools
- [Install TensorFlow 2](https://www.tensorflow.org/install): Installation guide for TensorFlow with pip, Docker, GPU support
- [Introduction to TensorFlow](https://www.tensorflow.org/learn): Beginner introduction to TensorFlow for desktop and mobile
- [Tutorials | TensorFlow Core](https://www.tensorflow.org/tutorials): Tutorials for TensorFlow with Keras, neural networks, training
- [Machine learning education | TensorFlow](https://www.tensorflow.org/resources/learn-ml): ML education curriculum covering coding, math, and theory

## Core Documentation

- [Guide | TensorFlow Core](https://www.tensorflow.org/guide): Comprehensive guide to TensorFlow concepts and APIs
- [Models & datasets | TensorFlow](https://www.tensorflow.org/resources/models-datasets): Repository of pre-trained models and datasets from community
- [Libraries & extensions | TensorFlow](https://www.tensorflow.org/resources/libraries-extensions): TensorFlow ecosystem libraries and domain-specific extensions
- [Tools | TensorFlow](https://www.tensorflow.org/resources/tools): Development tools and environments for TensorFlow workflows

## API Reference

- [TensorFlow API Versions | TensorFlow v2.16.1](https://www.tensorflow.org/api): TensorFlow API versions and release notes documentation
- [Module: tf | TensorFlow v2.16.1](https://www.tensorflow.org/api/stable): TensorFlow v2 stable Python API reference documentation
- [TensorFlow API Versions | TensorFlow v2.16.1](https://www.tensorflow.org/versions): TensorFlow version history and API documentation
- [TensorFlow.js API](https://js.tensorflow.org/api/latest): TensorFlow.js JavaScript API reference documentation
- [TFX API Reference | TensorFlow](https://www.tensorflow.org/tfx/api_docs): TensorFlow Extended production ML pipeline API reference

## Platform Ecosystems

- [TensorFlow.js | Machine Learning for JavaScript Developers](https://www.tensorflow.org/js): TensorFlow.js platform for JavaScript and browser ML
- [Google AI Edge | Google AI for Developers](https://www.tensorflow.org/lite): LiteRT/TensorFlow Lite for edge and on-device inference
- [TFX | ML Production Pipelines | TensorFlow](https://www.tensorflow.org/tfx): TensorFlow Extended for end-to-end production ML pipelines

## Advanced Topics

- [Responsible AI Toolkit | TensorFlow](https://www.tensorflow.org/responsible_ai): Responsible AI practices and tools for ML fairness and privacy
- [Recommendation systems | TensorFlow](https://www.tensorflow.org/resources/recommendation-systems): TensorFlow Recommenders for production recommendation systems
